headline: Ramayana Day 21: ₹9.60 Cr India nett
lede: 13:00 IST: Ramayana Day 21: ₹9.60 Cr India nett
body:
## 13:00 IST — Occupancy and bookings

Through Day 21 the desk has Ramayana at ₹992.2 Cr India nett, ₹1,173.6 Cr India gross, ₹582.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,755.6 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹982.55 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹4.10 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹2.70 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. Business Today is citing about ₹1,000.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹992.2 Cr India nett and ₹1,755.6 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.

editions.headline: Ramayana Day 21: ₹9.60 Cr India nett
editions.lede: Ramayana on Day 21 (Thursday, 26 November 2026) is at ₹9.60 Cr India nett and ₹11.45 Cr India gross, -45.1% from Day 20's ₹17.50 Cr. The board has 15,700 shows at 12.7% occupancy. Trade notes mention advance bookings, but no separate booking total is published here. The day is still open, so this is not the final figure.
